title: Sofa Mosque, Topkapi Palace
visualBrief: Sofa Mosque: small pale rectangular prayer hall with four tall pointed windows along its garden side, three front bays and a real central entry, fine brown window mullions, shallow lead cushion roof, paneled upper frieze/cornice and a short attached cylindrical stone minaret with moulded balcony support, a genuinely pierced lozenge guard, blunt rounded cap and finial. Plain interior; no copied inscriptions/art, chandelier, furnishings or independent neighbouring palace range.

Minaret is at the far entrance corner, inside the parent footprint.
